de.name: Bundesliga
hist: This season so far, with prior
de.histNote: The settings were tuned on Premier League data. The goal level comes from last season’s average and the 34-game season is allowed for. The market scored better in both checks. The relegation chance counts the bottom two only, not the play-off place.

fr.name: Ligue 1

fr.histNote: Ligue 1 was added later, so there is only the check on this season so far. The settings were tuned on Premier League data and are copied from the Bundesliga, which also has 18 clubs and 34 games. The goal level comes from last season’s average. The relegation chance counts the bottom two only, not the play-off place. Treat this as a small sample.
